original.target_description: Published article, single laboratory experiment: communication versus no communication for contributions to within-group pool W in the IPD-MD game; analyses reported at the 3-person-group level.

n.sample_role: 3-person groups, rather than individual participants; the paper states twenty groups per experimental condition, but the analytic sample for this specific t test is not unambiguously established.
n.exclusions: No exclusions for this test are stated. The printed t(29) does not transparently reconcile with twenty groups in each of the two IPD-MD conditions.

p.location: p. 408 (PDF p. 4), Results, top of right column, same pool-W communication comparison

notes: Only the assigned original side was examined. Title and authors match the supplied reference; source is the published article. The locator and outcome identify the pool-W communication comparison, reported as an increase from 47% without communication to 68% after communication. The requested printed test statistic is retained without conversion. The frozen text renders equals signs as 5; quotations preserve that rendering, while test_statistic normalizes the equality sign. Analytic n is left null because the target t(29) is not clearly reconciled with the general statement of twenty 3-person groups per condition; the total of 240 male participants is not substituted. Replication and reported_success are unassigned placeholders.
